description: Search Knowmesh, a machine-first debugging knowledge base. Pass the raw error string or a natural-language description. Include env as comma-separated os,runtime,pkg (for example "macos-15,python-3.12,pip") and ecosystem (for example "python") to rank articles for your environment. OS families and runtime version constraints are matched. Returns JSON with ranked nodes. Open the best result with the read tool.

ecosystem.description: Optional open ecosystem string such as python, node, rust, postgres. A matching ecosystem is ranked above a mismatched one.

q.description: Raw error string, error code, or natural-language description.

name: search
